scope: Assessment and proposed work only. No disposition is closed, waived, or reclassified.

historical-certification-check.classification: stale historical artifact; cross-version dependency design limitation
historical-certification-check.rootCause: The unchanged PHP 8.5 generator hashes whole src/tests/grammar/bin/tools trees plus explicit policy inputs. Its 1545-input historical ledger differs from the 2030-input Phase 7B baseline: 12 changed paths and 485 additions, no missing old paths. All 1437 protected 8.5 files remain unchanged.
historical-certification-check.smallestLegitimateRemediation: Separately authorize a PHP 8.5 current-tree evidence review. Preserve the original final ledger at its historical commit; review every changed shared dependency and current release gate. Propose a version-scoped historical record plus a separately hashed shared-integration attestation, or an explicitly authorized complete current-tree refresh. Do not just replace hashes or omit policy files.
historical-certification-check.gateB: No normative edit proposed. Any discovered grammar defect requires a separate version-specific source-backed correction and regression coverage.
dependencies: Audit all legacy release freshness gates
Authorize an evidence-format/dependency change or historical refresh separately
historical-certification-check.canProceedNow: READY: evidence and scope for the remediation proposal are available; implementation/refresh needs separate authorization.
historical-certification-check.upstreamClarification: Not required to diagnose freshness; any discovered language defect must follow source policy.
historical-certification-check.finalReleaseReconciliation: Not required for this PHP 8.5 freshness issue.
historical-certification-check.closureVerification: Verify original 8.5 hashes, independent before/after shared behavior, all legacy release gates, changed/missing/added dependency negative tests, and an explicit bounded claim review. Current failure remains visible until then.

production-coverage-closure.rootCause: 64 of 361 canonical productions remain unexercised: 52 primitive-bypassed, 11 trivia-removed, and reserved-non-modifiers. Classification is not proof of every source/scanner abstraction.
production-coverage-closure.smallestLegitimateRemediation: Review each remaining production identity at RC4, independently justify primitive/trivia abstractions, and supply a targeted accepted witness or evidenced contextual-only disposition for reserved-non-modifiers. Keep all identities and denominators.
production-coverage-closure.gateB: Evidence-only work can precede grammar edits; any newly demonstrated mismatch needs exact-pin source, minimal change, parity and boundary regressions before a correction.
dependencies: PHP86-013 for newly implicated source paths
production-coverage-closure.canProceedNow: READY WITH BOUNDED LIMITATIONS: current RC4 supports focused review and witnesses.
production-coverage-closure.upstreamClarification: Only if a targeted validity discrepancy cannot be settled from the pin.
production-coverage-closure.finalReleaseReconciliation: Not needed to research RC4; required separately for final-release claims.
production-coverage-closure.closureVerification: Recompute every production identity and witness, verify justified exclusions independently, preserve denominators, and obtain an explicit completeness disposition rather than a percentage target.

alternative-coverage-closure.classification: missing alternative-specific evidence and unresolved lexical identity
alternative-coverage-closure.rootCause: 318 of 800 alternatives are unexercised: 174 primitive-bypassed, 9 trivia-removed, 134 meaningful gaps and one unresolved context-only from identity.
alternative-coverage-closure.smallestLegitimateRemediation: Work through the exact alternative IDs, prioritizing reserved-non-modifiers/alternative:25, namespace/type/declaration and dereference/constructor boundaries, then closed-yield/prefix/dangling-else binding. Add accepted witnesses plus nearby negative/stage controls or justified source-backed dispositions.
alternative-coverage-closure.gateB: Do not remove or restructure alternatives to improve coverage. Any real correction requires source proof, parity and regression/boundary evidence.
alternative-coverage-closure.canProceedNow: READY WITH BOUNDED LIMITATIONS: independent finite witnesses can be developed at RC4.
alternative-coverage-closure.upstreamClarification: Conditional on discoveries; from token/category semantics first require source investigation.
alternative-coverage-closure.closureVerification: No unexplained alternative or source association; reviewed residual identities, fresh positive/negative evidence and independent binding checks.

scanner-state-closure.rootCause: 190 headers and eleven states are inventoried, but only 34 rule ranges associate with the 51 later lexical entries; 156 have family-level evidence. Range overlap is not an instrumented rule hit.
scanner-state-closure.smallestLegitimateRemediation: Establish independent RC4 witnesses/dispositions for rule-state transitions and helper/error paths, especially interpolation, heredoc nesting/indentation/lookahead, EOF, reentrant exceptions and token categories. State the byte-profile bounds explicitly.
scanner-state-closure.gateB: Only evidence-backed scanner defects may change the adapter; preserve both-version token and boundary regressions.
scanner-state-closure.canProceedNow: READY WITH BOUNDED LIMITATIONS: source review and distribution-backed probes can proceed; exact correspondence needs build evidence.
scanner-state-closure.upstreamClarification: Conditional if source and observed scanner behavior disagree.
scanner-state-closure.finalReleaseReconciliation: Required later; ZTS/multibyte profiles remain outside current claims.
scanner-state-closure.closureVerification: Independently reviewed rule/state/helper ledger with witnesses or justified bounds, both short-tag profiles, negative/error cases and no invented scanner coverage numerator.

ast-binding.rootCause: Parser-family mapping and finite acceptance do not prove operand spans, AST construction, aggregate interpolation binding or individual upstream-alternative equivalence.
ast-binding.smallestLegitimateRemediation: Create RC4-specific operand/derivation or compatible AST-oracle comparisons for changed PFA call lists, closed-yield/prefix interactions, dangling else and aggregate interpolation. Retain intentional ambiguities with independently normalized comparisons.
ast-binding.gateB: Binding corrections require immutable parser/action evidence, smallest structural change, parity and focused neighboring-boundary tests.
dependencies: Independent RC4 derivation/AST adapter and oracle provenance
ast-binding.canProceedNow: READY WITH BOUNDED LIMITATIONS: source and operand-span work can start; oracle/adapter support remains a prerequisite.
ast-binding.upstreamClarification: Conditional on mismatches; no inheritance of PHP 8.5 binding conclusions.
ast-binding.closureVerification: Fresh independent binding matrices with precise supported scopes, rejected/malformed controls, remaining ambiguity dispositions and verified oracle/build identity.

folding-order.classification: unresolved language/compatibility discrepancy and incomplete traversal evidence
folding-order.rootCause: Optimized printf/sprintf and array/constant traversal differ from ordinary calls; current observations do not define a universal intended discarded-expression validity rule.
folding-order.smallestLegitimateRemediation: Map exact dispatch and visited-AST ordering at RC4 and resolve intended compatibility with primary upstream evidence. Preserve direct/imported/qualified/namespaced/dynamic calls, named/unpacked/PFA arguments and logical/ternary/coalesce/array live/discarded controls.
folding-order.gateB: Any specification/grammar correction needs resolved intended scope, pinned source and positive/negative retained/discarded tests; no builtin-specific EBNF speculation.
folding-order.canProceedNow: READY WITH BOUNDED LIMITATIONS: RC4 source/dispatch analysis and reproductions can proceed; closure is not established.
folding-order.upstreamClarification: Required for the general intended compatibility boundary; existing PR 19658 discussion is insufficient.
folding-order.finalReleaseReconciliation: A later fix/pin review may be needed; do not assume the final release resolves intent.
folding-order.closureVerification: Reviewed dispatch/predicate matrix, authoritative intended boundary, corresponding build observations and no unexplained validity differences in the retained controls.

discovery-closure.rootCause: The 578-hunk inventory retains 230 pending-direct-review and 14 examined-unresolved records, plus bounded semantic groups, unassociated PHPTs and transitive/outside-ledger paths.
discovery-closure.smallestLegitimateRemediation: Review prioritized exact hunk IDs and transitive compiler/AST/optimizer/linking/VM paths, associate upstream tests and RFC components/reversions, and record source-backed exclusions or verified changes. Do not treat reviewed hunk counts as semantic closure.
discovery-closure.gateB: Any newly verified syntax change needs affected productions/layers, immutable source/test evidence and positive/negative/stage/version-boundary obligations before edits.
dependencies: PHP86-014 and PHP86-015 for affected semantic groups
Independent review of unassociated source/test paths
discovery-closure.canProceedNow: READY WITH BOUNDED LIMITATIONS: substantial RC4 discovery work is possible now; uncertain groups remain blocked.
discovery-closure.upstreamClarification: Required where exact source behavior does not establish intended language validity.
discovery-closure.finalReleaseReconciliation: Not needed to complete RC4 discovery; later RC/final deltas require a separate review.
discovery-closure.closureVerification: Every material finding has a reviewed disposition, source mapping, tests or evidenced exclusion; all pending and unresolved identities are resolved rather than hidden by aggregate counts.

writable-target-validity.classification: unresolved intended validity with compiler/VM inconsistencies
writable-target-validity.rootCause: Assignment/reference/list-derived property and dimension writes can lint successfully but reach inconsistent compiler/VM paths. Neither runtime failure nor successful reference-result execution defines intended structural validity.
writable-target-validity.smallestLegitimateRemediation: Obtain an authoritative intended-validity decision for the exact forms and a coherent implementation disposition/fix. Reproduce using source-corresponding builds, separating ordinary/reference/list bases, result types and property/dimension/compound/inc/unset/reference operations.
writable-target-validity.gateB: Only after intent and implementation are reconciled: smallest contextual or normative correction, paired live/discarded controls, both-version boundaries and compiler/VM evidence. PHP86-004 constant-object rules stay separate.
dependencies: Upstream intended-validity clarification and possibly a fix at a subsequently reviewed pin
writable-target-validity.canProceedNow: READY WITH BOUNDED LIMITATIONS: minimized reproductions and source analysis are possible; full closure cannot be claimed at RC4 today.
writable-target-validity.upstreamClarification: Required; PR 20628 comments do not decide the exact target forms.
writable-target-validity.finalReleaseReconciliation: A later corrected pin may be needed, but a final release label alone is not proof.
writable-target-validity.closureVerification: Authoritative decision plus coherent source/VM behavior and stage-specific regressions; no unsupported inference from lint/runtime observations.

contextual-enforcement-scope.classification: incomplete contextual predicate evidence and unadjudicated claim scope
contextual-enforcement-scope.rootCause: 73 restriction descriptions have family mappings, not 73 isolated RC4 predicates; the matcher is not a complete contextual validator.
contextual-enforcement-scope.smallestLegitimateRemediation: Map remaining source guards and their parser/compiler/folding/link stages to isolated valid/invalid controls. Then independently adjudicate a bounded grammar claim with explicit external constraints. A whole-source-validator claim would additionally require implemented supported/unsupported contextual validation.
contextual-enforcement-scope.gateB: Any newly discovered normative restriction requires source, affected layer, enforcement status, parity and retained/discarded/boundary evidence before correction.
contextual-enforcement-scope.canProceedNow: READY WITH BOUNDED LIMITATIONS: predicate isolation can proceed; scope acceptance cannot be assumed.
contextual-enforcement-scope.upstreamClarification: Required for the linked unresolved language findings, not for every ordinary predicate.
contextual-enforcement-scope.closureVerification: Independent predicate/stage evidence and authorized bounded-claim disposition; never count structural matches of contextual negatives as whole-source rejection.

discarded-hook-disposition.classification: known inherited structural discrepancy requiring independent policy disposition
discarded-hook-disposition.rootCause: The get/set-only grammar rejects an unknown hook name that Zend can accept when its declaration is discarded.
discarded-hook-disposition.smallestLegitimateRemediation: Independently decide whether the precisely bounded grammar claim may retain this divergence or requires a PHP 8.6 correction. Keep the PHP 8.5 decision historical; it is not automatic permission for PHP 8.6.
discarded-hook-disposition.gateB: If correction is authorized, prove identifier-hook parsing plus surviving get/set validation with live/discarded controls, parity and a separate historical-version review. No correction is performed here.
discarded-hook-disposition.canProceedNow: READY WITH BOUNDED LIMITATIONS: evidence supports a concrete policy proposal; no automatic acceptance as a limitation.
discarded-hook-disposition.upstreamClarification: Not inherently required for the observed pin behavior; review intent if an equivalence correction is proposed.
discarded-hook-disposition.closureVerification: Signed-off bounded scope or a source-backed separately authorized correction, fresh live/discarded regressions, and unchanged 8.5 historical artifacts.

exact-pin-executable.classification: source-provenance limitation; unavailable build prerequisites; attestation tooling gap
exact-pin-executable.rootCause: Distribution hashes/version strings do not attest source ancestry. VS 2022 C++ is installed but unconfigured; PHP SDK/dependency tools and bison/re2c are unavailable in the checked environment. No Docker/Podman or WSL distribution is available. The existing provenance validator also rejects every attestation by construction.
exact-pin-executable.smallestLegitimateRemediation: Provision a disposable supported SDK/toolchain and dependencies, build the immutable source without changing host PHP, and retain source tree/acquisition, clean-tree, compiler/dependency, generated parser/scanner/header/configuration, command/log and binary hashes. Separately implement and test a reviewed attestation verifier instead of deleting the guard.
exact-pin-executable.gateB: No grammar edit implied. Any source revision change needs separately reviewed incremental pin/source/test correspondence.
dependencies: Supported PHP SDK and dependency bundle
exact-pin-executable.canProceedNow: READY WITH BOUNDED LIMITATIONS for a provisioning/attestation proposal; NOT READY for an exact-pin build with current prerequisites.
exact-pin-executable.upstreamClarification: Not needed to provision an RC4 build; it does not resolve PHP86-014/015 intent.
exact-pin-executable.finalReleaseReconciliation: Not needed for an RC4 build; mandatory separately for final PHP 8.6 certification.
exact-pin-executable.closureVerification: Independently validated complete build attestation, actual tested binary identity and explicit configuration, negative attestation tests, then all differential and release gates rerun.

infrastructureProposal.status: proposed only; existing gate semantics unchanged
findings: --run always refuses and invokes no full gate sequence; --prepare is the only executable gate orchestrator.
claimErrors always adds a Phase 7A authorization error even though the user has now authorized Phase 7B assessment.
Closure gates require blocked status by construction and provenanceErrors always fails; valid future closure/build evidence cannot be recognized.
Fixed output locations would overwrite Phase 7A evidence; --report relocates only the final ledger, not child artifacts.

Whole-repository input enumeration intentionally detects changes, but also makes an old 8.6 report stale when new assessment documentation/tools are added. Historical artifact preservation and current-tree freshness are distinct.

The 8.6 claim checker treats the historical 8.5 freshness check as mandatory, explicitly coupling current 8.6 eligibility to a repository-wide 8.5 historical digest. That is a cross-version lifecycle design limitation, not proof of a PHP 8.6 syntax defect.
infrastructureProposal.proposal: Separately authorize run-specific output roots, versioned evidence schemas and explicit claim/phase policy. Keep failure defaults; introduce evidence-backed closure and provenance validators only after review. Separate immutable historical validity from current shared-integration verification without silently removing any existing gate.
infrastructureProposal.verification: Test passing, failed, missing, stale and wrong-version evidence; legitimate and forged build attestations; every required gate; additions/deletions; read-only validation; preserved earlier runs; unchanged old release behavior; and inability to certify while mandatory blockers remain.
